'''2010 Worlds Day 2 Chris Gogolen DS Imperial Occupation''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Chris Gogolen]] at [[2010 World Championship]] (Day 2).

Deck name on sheet: It worked in 2003...

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Imperial Occupation / Local Uprising|Imperial Occupation / Local Uprising (V)]]
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
